clauses.why: The verses say Jacob named the place and set up the stone; the place itself was not the one who was named by him in the sense of being the actor, but the clause is fine apart from the pillar being a minor detail beside the naming; it also drops the verse-17 fear, which is not needed.
clauses.english: was named Bethel by Jacob, who set up a stone pillar there
clauses.ukr: Яків назвав це місце Бет-Елом, поставивши там каменя за пам'ятника
clauses.deu: wurde von Jakob Beth-El genannt, der dort einen Stein zu einem Mal aufrichtete
clauses.spa: Jacob lo llamó Beth-el, después de alzar allí una piedra por título

clauses.why: The calf was set in Bethel (12:29) and Jeroboam offered on the altar there (12:33); verse 28 only tells of making the calves, and the 'golden' detail is in 12:28 but the clause can rest on 29 and 33.
clauses.english: was where Jeroboam set up a golden calf and offered on his altar
clauses.ukr: Єровоам поставив там золотого тельця і приносив жертви на своєму жертівнику
clauses.deu: Jerobeam setzte dort ein goldenes Kalb auf und opferte auf seinem Altar
clauses.spa: Jeroboam puso allí un becerro de oro y sacrificó sobre su altar

clauses.why: The verse says Josiah broke down the altar and high place and burned the high place; 'its altar and high place' fits, but the clause omits nothing wrong; the grammatical subject must be the place, so it is kept with a clearer form.
clauses.english: had its altar and high place broken down by Josiah, who burned the high place
clauses.ukr: Йосія розбив там жертівника й пагірка та спалив пагірка
clauses.deu: Josia brach dort den Altar und die Höhe ab und verbrannte die Höhe
clauses.spa: Josías destruyó allí el altar y el alto, y quemó el alto
